notes.title: Update on The Green Book: What’s Next?
notes.content:
Hello, Green Book Community!

We wanted to share an important update with you all. Unfortunately, our recent Kickstarter campaign didn’t reach its funding goal. While this was a tough outcome, we’re incredibly grateful for the support and enthusiasm we received from our amazing community. Your belief in The Green Book has been truly inspiring.

[b]What’s Next for The Green Book?[/b]

We’re not giving up on our vision. We remain fully committed to bringing The Green Book to life and are currently exploring different ways to make it happen. This project is close to our hearts, and with your continued support, we know we can achieve something truly special.

[b]Stay Connected[/b]

If you’d like to stay updated on our progress, please consider joining our Discord server or following us on social media. We’ll be sharing updates, sneak peeks, and more as we move forward.

Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/Tj5UhBvPdR]discord.gg/Tj5UhBvPdR[/url]
Twitter: [url=https://x.com/tapteek]x.com/tapteek[/url]

Thank you for being part of this journey with us. Your support means everything, and we can’t wait to share what’s next for The Green Book with you. 🪴💚

notes.title: Less than two weeks left. We need your support! 🪴💚
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We have less than two weeks left, and unfortunately, it looks like we won’t be able to successfully complete the Kickstarter campaign for The Green Book. 📗🐻

We truly need your support right now. Please consider sharing the game and the Kickstarter campaign with your friends and followers. With your help, we might still have a chance. 

A very special thank you to everyone who has backed the Kickstarter already! And thank you to everyone who has player the demo so far, and to those that have left feedback. We are truly grateful! 🪴💚

You can back the project here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/theeugene/the-green-book-0/

notes.title: Kickstarter is now live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're thrilled to announce that our Kickstarter campaign for The Green Book is now live! 🪴🌱🌟

Support us on Kickstarter and help us bring this magical world to life. Your backing will allow us to add more content, enhance features, and ensure The Green Book becomes the relaxing and delightful experience we envision.

Check out our Kickstarter campaign here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/theeugene/the-green-book-0]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/theeugene/the-green-book-0[/url]

A very special thank you to everyone who has backed the Kickstarter already! And thank you to everyone who has player the demo so far, to everyone who has wishlisted, and to those that have left feedback. We are truly grateful!

Thank you for your support and happy gardening! 🌿✨
